scope: Extend the existing ERC4626 Family with the source-bound synchronous FrxUSDCustodianUsdc 0.2.8 variant; retain standard ERC4626 behavior and activation defaults.
Derive the transparent-proxy admin from its normalized complete bytecode template, authenticate EIP1967 implementation/code and external share/asset binding; no target-address admission allowlist.
External frxUSD shares are distinct from the custodian address. Deposit mints external shares; redeem burns external shares and synchronously pays USDC.
Only the Custodian variant refreshes each block, because fee setters can change behavior without emitting a vault event.

Keep specified-amount Exact/quoted execution and independent runtime-actual construction; approve only the actual input, clean allowance, enforce exact debit, actual receipt and external share supply change.
Operator/RWA shuffle and asynchronous withdrawal operations are not adapted.
